This book is intriguing as it talks about many similar things to what people in mystical states mention such as seeing into parallel dimensions and interacting with beings from other worlds etc.

● Other Dimensions - Levels Of Dimensions spanning into the microcosm and also outwards into the macrocosm

as an additional question is aerobic exercise all about the heart rate?
What is the difference between aerobic and anaerobic exercise?

Aerobic, think about walking and/or going for a jog. Anaerobic, think sprinting as hard and as fast as you can. I always try to frame it as think of how hard you're breathing when you do the two activities, or how your heart rate is. It's elevated higher than normal, but it's not pounding in your chest ridiculous or anything when you're just out for a jog. You're breathing harder but it's not like you're struggling to catch your breath (well, maybe at the end). Anaerobic, you're basically taking in big gulps of air, your heart is pounding as fast as it goes, and you know you're not going to be able to keep that activity up for a super long time.

One thing you can do is work both into your workout for your running is like so. A mile or two into your jog, or towards the end of it depending on how far you normally go, sprint a hundred meters, then jog a hundred meters, then sprint a hundred, then jog a hundred. Make sure to finish out with walking/jogging for a few hundred meters though after, it's not super good to sprint as hard as you can and then just sit down/collapse right after.
